conditions.metric_note: sum_test_time_s = Σ per-test durations from nextest junit (one process per test). It is NOT the libtest Σ per-binary `finished in` (1,871 s, 17-8 log) — under nextest, the 13 xtask integration binaries' per-test `cargo run -p xtask` calls run in parallel and serialise on cargo's build-directory lock, so every waiting test is charged the wait. Wall (226 s test phase) is the cost an operator pays; Σ is the budget metric AC1 caps at 300 s.
